depends_on: two-variable Euler-product lemma (p-local Dwork) in Lean
notes: p not dividing q: two-variable Euler-product lemma with r=1/q a p-adic unit (as for A157675). p | q: induction v_p([x^N]A) >= -v_p(q) C(N,2), slack C(n,2) >= v_p(n) in the log and sum_{i<j} N_i N_j >= C(k,2) >= v_p(k!) in exp. Outside Lean: all. The mod-q conjecture is not treated (holds numerically n<=11).
